name: Boomeranging
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 12th; Craft Magic Arms and Armor; telekinesis; Price +2 bonus and + 2,000 gp.

DESCRIPTION

This thrown weapon allows you to attack a creature as if you were able to make iterative attacks with it though it does not return to your hand. The very first time a creature is attacked by your second attack in a round, that creature makes a Will save (DC 10 + ½ your character level + your Strength or Dexterity modifier) or be caught flat-footed. At the end of your last attack for the round, the weapon then returns to you.
